name: Club challenge
summary: Run a club challenge with a shared plan and each member's own private layer of targets.

onboarding.prompt: How should members set their own targets?
Tap the weekly club check-in time.

plan_blueprint.calendar: A weekly club check-in, kick-off and finish events. Week counts follow the chosen dates.

approach_variants.habit: Each member gets a small daily action tied to their routine; member streaks.
approach_variants.willpower: Team leaderboard for members who opt in, plus weekly club dares.
approach_variants.time: Club sessions and each member's actions are calendar blocks.
approach_variants.reward: A shared reward the club picks for the finish, plus personal rewards per member.
approach_variants.resource: Kick-off week gathers supplies, buddies and the member list.

guardrails: Members choose their own visibility; the leader sees only what each member shares.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: Members who miss a week get a gentle nudge and a smaller next-week target.

creator.license: GoalKin launch template; replaced when a creator version is approved

price_log.basis: Launch proposal per docs/MARKETPLACE.md; pending owner approval
